zh.headline: 基因型到表型调控的数学原理
zh.intro: 我现任中国科学院数学与系统科学研究院优青副研究员（Tenure-track associate professor），研究数学优化、大语言模型机器学习与计算生物学的交叉领域，致力于理解从基因型到表型的调控机制。
zh.research_text: 遗传变异通过转录因子（TF）、调控元件（RE）和靶基因（TG）等分子，并与环境因素相互作用，共同影响表型。结合统计推断、网络理论与深度学习、大模型，从 DNA 序列、单细胞染色质可及性和基因表达等高维噪声数据中，构建可解释、可预测的数学模型。
questions: Sequence to function model: 如何建模预测DNA序列和遗传变异对细胞分子功能控制？
Combinatorial regulation model: 如何建模组合调控定量描述细胞分子的协同作用？
Genotype to phenotype model: 如何以分子调控为媒介，建立从基因型预测表型的因果数学模型？
zh.figure_alt: 从基因型到表型的基因调控研究框架
zh.figure_caption: 从序列与遗传变异，到分子调控网络，再到细胞状态与表型。

en.name: Zhanying Feng
en.title: Zhanying Feng | AMSS, Chinese Academy of Sciences
en.description: Zhanying Feng is a tenure-track associate professor at the Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences, working on mathematical optimization, machine learning, and computational biology.
en.institution: Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences
en.headline: The mathematics of genotype-to-phenotype regulation
en.intro: I am a tenure-track associate professor at the Academy of Mathematics and Systems Science, Chinese Academy of Sciences. My research lies at the intersection of mathematical optimization, machine learning with large language models, and computational biology, with a focus on understanding regulatory mechanisms linking genotypes to phenotypes.
en.research_text: Genetic variants influence transcription factors (TFs), regulatory elements (REs), and target genes (TGs), which interact with environmental factors to shape phenotypes. I combine statistical inference, network theory, deep learning, and large models to build interpretable, predictive mathematical models from high-dimensional, noisy data, including DNA sequences, single-cell chromatin accessibility, and gene expression.
questions: Sequence-to-function models: How can we model and predict how DNA sequences and genetic variants control cellular molecular functions?
Combinatorial regulation model: How can we model combinatorial regulation to quantitatively describe the coordinated actions of cellular molecules?
Genotype-to-phenotype models: How can we build causal mathematical models that predict phenotypes from genotypes through molecular regulation?
en.figure_caption: From sequences and genetic variants to regulatory networks, cell states, and phenotypes.
